note: What a client sends once it has loaded and is ready to play. It comes unprompted, before any start of play reaches the client.

fields.name: moduleOne
fields.note: One of three values a client reports about software it has detected alongside itself. Observed as zero.

fields.name: tipChosen
fields.note: Which tip the client is set to show.

bits.name: tips
bits.note: Set while tips are wanted at all.

bits.name: reporting
bits.note: Set while the client reports on itself.

bits.name: loadingTips
bits.note: Set while tips are wanted while loading.

bits.name: playingTips
bits.note: Set while tips are wanted during play.

bits.name: debug
bits.note: Set while the client runs in a debugging state.

bits.name: unknown
bits.note: Purpose undetermined. A client leaves these as it found them, so they carry values it never wrote for this message.

fields.name: moduleTwo
fields.note: The second of the three. Observed as zero.
